thread:
marie: Quick PSA — final changelog sweep before the v0.9.0 cutoff. Please add entries to KEEP_A_CHANGELOG.md or the release notes template by EOD PT. Post short bullets only. Format check below.

sam: Which component tag should I use for the runtime perf fix? runtime/serving or eng-runtime?

devon: runtime/serving is fine for surface area. Also include PR number and backport-owner.

marie: Template we expect:
```
- component: <component> (e.g. runtime/serving)
- type: improvement / bug / docs / chore
- description: one short sentence (imperative)
- pr: #1234
- backport-owner: @handle or none
```

ryan: Added entry for #2345: perf improvement to KV cache warmup, backport -> @devon. Short desc: "Improve KV cache warmup to reduce cold-start tail latency."

devon: Got the backport. I'll handle release-0.8 tomorrow AM.

sam: Quick nit — are we still preferring "improvement" over "perf"? I recall two styles floating around.

marie: Use "improvement" per the template (we consolidated last week). I'll update the comment in the template to avoid confusion.

sam: Cool. Also ran the lint locally: `scripts/changelog_lint.sh --check` — flagged a couple missing PR fields earlier.

release-bot: deploy-bot: changelog-lint passed for PR #2345 (:white_check_mark:)

sam: Cutoff reminder — cutoff is 17:00 PT today, correct?

marie: Correct. 17:00 PT. After that, only critical/security fixes allowed and they need a release-manager sign-off.

ryan: Adding a one-liner for #2350 (docs) now.

devon: If anyone has a vague description, ping me — I'll help convert to the one-line imperative style.

sam: Done — updated my entries and fixed the PR references. Thanks everyone :rocket:

marie: Thanks — I'll do a quick sweep 30m before cutoff and post a final list.
